title: Weekly controller digest
prompt: Each week, review overdue receivables, upcoming payments, cash availability and forecast changes. Highlight items requiring action.

inputs.name: Cash forecast workbook kept outside Dime

steps: pull the AR aging, upcoming bill payments, bank balances and the latest forecast
list overdue receivables, payments due within two weeks and cash shortfalls
compare the forecast with last week's and note the changes
write the digest with an as-of date and no repeated alerts

done.text: Every exception row cites the customer, bill or account id
controller-digest.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every section shows its as-of date; items already reported last week are marked as repeats, not re-alerted
